ipos.brief: Kolkata-region maker of flexible packaging materials sold mainly business-to-business, incorporated in December 2018. West Bengal is its principal market although it supplies customers across India; its top 10 customers made up about 70% of FY26 revenue.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (₹189.43 cr at ₹94)

ipos.brief: Vadodara-based precision engineering company with manufacturing, services and trading arms. Its core product line is precision-engineered components for underwater pelletizing systems used in plastics processing.

Makes geophones, seismic cables and geophysical connectors for oil, gas and geoscience exploration at a plant in Manesar, Haryana. Founded in 1986 as Geosource India, in collaboration with Geosource Inc., USA.

ipos.company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
ipos.brief: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited processes and manufactures steel coils into processed steel products in India and Internationally. Its products include hard roll pickled and oiled, cold rolled close annealed, cold rolled full hard steel, half hard temper, galvanised plain skin pass, galvanised plain regular spangle, pre-painted galvanised iron, and PPGI EMBO coil and sheets. Its services include steel processing services including slitting, cut-to-length, shearing, and embossing. It caters to original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers in home and commercial appliances and general engineering sectors. Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

ipos.company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
ipos.brief: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited manufactures and retails jewelry. The company offers gold, diamond, and cubic zirconia jewelry, such as rings, earrings, necklace, pendant sets, chains, bangles, bracelets, and mangalasutras. It sells its products through multiple retail jewellery stores and online channels. The company markets its branded collections, such as Nayaab, Sitaare, Sunehre, Masoom, and the CZ Collection. The company was formerly known as M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Private Limited and changed its name to M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited in January 2025. M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Mumbai, India.

SFC Environmental Technologies Limited engages in the design, technology, manufacturing, supply and supervision for installation and commissioning of equipment for the treatment of wastewater and solid waste in India and internationally. The company offers Cyclic activated sludge technology (C-Tech), a technology for treating sewage and effluents. The company's C-Tech technology solutions include decanters, diffusers, air blowers, fiber disc filters, solar sludge drying system along with programmable logic controllers, and supervisory control and data acquisition-based automation solutions; and operations and maintenance services, and related accessories. It also provides OREX multi-stage system to separate biodegradable organics from inorganic materials and lignocellulosic fibers from mixed municipal wastes for solid waste treatment plants. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Thane, India.

BLS Polymers Limited manufactures polymer compounds for the wire and cable and industrial pipeline coating industries. The company operates through two segments: Polymer and Trading. The company manufactures polyethylene compounds, including high-density polyethylene, medium-density polyethylene, low-density polyethylene, and linear low-density polyethylene variants, used for insulation, jacketing, and sheathing of power, telecom, and optical fiber cables. It also manufactures cross-linked polyethylene compounds, silane-grafted, for insulation of low-tension and high-tension power cables, including aerial bunched cables. Additionally, the company manufactures halogen-free flame retardant compounds for insulation and jacketing of cables, as well as polyvinyl chloride compounds for insulation and sheathing of power, data, signaling, automotive, and house wiring cables. It also offers cable filling compounds for moisture resistance and insulation in telecom cables, along with specialty additive, black, and white masterbatches for polymer products. For industrial pipeline coating applications, the company manufactures high-density polyethylene top coat compounds for the outer layer of three-layer polyethylene pipeline coating systems used on oil, gas, and water distribution pipelines, and polypropylene top coat compounds for three-layer polypropylene pipeline coating applications. It also manufactures adhesive compounds, which serve as intermediate layer adhesives for bonding between the fusion bonded epoxy base layer and the top coat layer in three-layer pipeline coating systems. Additionally, the company trades polymers and operates as a stockist and distributor of polymer products. BLS Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.

EAAA India Alternatives Limited is an investment firm focused on Private Credit, Infrastructure, Real Estate, and Private Equity, specializing in Private Credit, Special Situation, Distressed Debt, Infrastructure Debt, Real Estate Debt, and Private Equity strategies. The firm primarily targets investments in office properties, mid-income and affordable housing developments, energy assets, renewable energy projects, climate mitigation and adaptation initiatives, operating infrastructure assets, and mid-stage operating companies. It focuses its investments in India. The firm seeks to provide structured credit and financing solutions to corporates, projects, or sponsors across the risk spectrum. It operates a diversified, multi-strategy platform focusing on yielding investments and debt financing. The firm provides credit solutions, special situations funding, real estate credit, investment-grade credit, infrastructure yield investments, commercial real estate yield acquisitions, perpetual capital, and energy transition funding. It looks to acquire, operate, and manage infrastructure assets with low counterparty risk, long residual tenures, and low operating costs. The firm also offers co-investment opportunities to its clients through portfolio management services. It manages alternative investment funds and offers both onshore and offshore investment solutions. EAAA India Alternatives Limited, formerly known as Edelweiss Alternative Asset Advisors Limited, is based in Mumbai, India, with additional offices in New Delhi, India; Gandhinagar, India; and Singapore.EAAA India Alternatives Limited operates as the operating subsidiary of Magnolia Commodities Services Private Limited.

Paras Healthcare Limited provides tertiary and quaternary healthcare services. The company provides cardiac sciences, neurosciences, oncology sciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics and sports injury, and renal sciences services. It offers services, such as cardio thoracic vascular surgery and cardiology; medical, radiation, surgical, and hemato oncology, as well as nuclear medicine and bone marrow transplant; and neuroscience, neuro intervention, neurology, and spine surgery. The company also provides gastrointestinal surgery, gastroenterology, and liver transplant; nephrology, urology, and kidney transplant; general and minimal access surgery, obstetrics, gynecology, paediatrics, internal medicine, pulmonology, plastic and reconstructive surgery, and endocrinology as well as ear, nose, throat, neck and head surgery. Paras Healthcare Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Jio Platforms Limited provides mobile and fixed broadband connectivity along with digital products, services, platforms, and applications across entertainment, gaming, cloud computing, cloud storage, and artificial intelligence in India. The company offers 4G and 5G mobile broadband connectivity, international roaming, eSIM, Wi-Fi calling, JioTunes, and VIP mobile numbers; and broadband services, including JioFiber, an optic fibre-based service, and JioAirFiber, a fixed wireless access service. The company also offers consumer entertainment services, including JioTV+ and JioTV for live TV, JioSaavn for music streaming, JioGames for cloud gaming, JioNews, and JioCinema, JioAICloud for cloud storage, JioPC for cloud-native virtual desktops, and JioPhotos for photo organization, along with devices such as Jio Bharat feature phones, the Jio Set-top-box, 5G radios, and JioFi hotspots. In addition, it develops JioFrames, an AI-powered wearable smart-glasses product; and Jio Set-top-box; and consumer applications, including MyJio, JioMart, JioFinance, JioGate, JioMeet, JioAirFiber, JioCDN, and JioChat, along with the HelloJio voice assistant and JioAds advertising platform. Further, it develops proprietary operating systems, including JioBharat OS, JioTele OS, and JioBrain. The company develops and provides JioRemote, JioExtender, routers, and USB cameras. Additionally, it offers JioBusiness services, JioPC, JioCloud infrastructure, JioCX communications platform, JioRaksha cybersecurity services, and the JioThings IoT platform, along with JioAttendance, Jio Hospitality solution (JHES), and JioRooms. It also provides satellite-based communication and international connectivity services. The company serves consumers, government, MSMEs, large enterprises, and startups. Jio Platforms Limited was founded in 2016 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India. Jio Platforms Limited operates as a subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited.

Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited manufactures custom-made industrial and consumer goods in India and globally. The company operates through two segments: Manufacturing Business and Ecosystem Business. The company's Manufacturing Business segment designs, manufactures, supplies, and installs products across energy, precision, and capital goods verticals. Under energy products, it offers fabricated steel structures, solar modules, solar tracker structure equipment, and transformers. Under precision products, the company manufactures smart ring components, engine parts, multi-layer PCBs, data center components, military grade connectors, high precision turbine blades, antennas, and electrical grounding clamps. Under capital goods, it manufactures LPG storage tanks, horton sphere, marine unloaders, CNG storage tanks, claus reactor, bullet train railway girders, machine components, finished industrial equipment, electro-mechanical assemblies, and products for robotics and automation. The company also manufactures electronics products, defense and aerospace components including parts for aerial vehicles, defense systems, aircraft, and rocket casings; and injection-molded components. Additionally, it offers prototyping and pre-production services, original design manufacturing for transformers, process plant machinery, and metal manufacturing and defense applications, job work on customer-supplied materials, and project engineering services. The company's Ecosystem Business segment sources and supplies industrial raw materials and commodities, including ferrous and non-ferrous metals, along with petrochemicals. It also provides manufacturing support services. It serves the transportation, industrial machinery and equipment, consumer products, electronics and appliances, construction and infrastructure, energy and utilities, and aerospace and defense industries. Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Tonbo Imaging India Limited designs, develops, and manufactures electro-optical and infrared sensing, processing, communication, and guidance systems for defense, surveillance, and security applications. The company's tactical products include thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, hand-held thermal imaging binoculars, and targeting systems. It also manufactures platform-level products, such as fire control systems, missile seekers, and missile guidance systems. Additionally, the company designs and manufactures embedded vision systems and AI-accelerated image processing subsystems, along with multi-axis gimbal stabilization systems for defense platforms. It serves global militaries, law enforcement agencies, homeland security agencies, and defense original equipment manufacturers. Tonbo Imaging India Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of Class III and Class C/D medical devices in India, Europe, rest of the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East and Africa. The company provides vascular intervention products coronary stents and balloons used to diagnose or treat diseases of the blood vessels; structural heart products comprising trans-catheter aortic valves and occluders used to treat defects or abnormalities in the heart's structure; and other products, such as renal stents, peripheral drug-coated balloon catheters, and other trading products. It also trades in and distributes medical devices/medical implants; and surgical, hospital, pharmaceutical, dental, laboratory, and orthopedic and traumatology products, materials, and equipment. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Surat, India.

Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited manufactures gearboxes, gear motors, and drive systems. The company operates through three segments: Industry and Automation, Off-Highway Mobility, and Wind. The company's Industry and Automation segment manufactures helical gearboxes, parallel shaft helical gearboxes, helical-bevel gearboxes, worm gearboxes, planetary gearboxes, industrial gear motors, precision planetary gearboxes and gearmotors, inverters, servo drives, and electric motors. The company's Off-Highway Mobility segment manufactures travel drives, slew drives, winch and hoisting drives, transit mixer drives, and high-torque planetary gearboxes for mobile and off-highway equipment. The company's Wind segment manufactures wind drive systems, including yaw and pitch solutions for wind turbine applications. The company also provides aftermarket services, including spares supply, repairs, rebuilds, and retrofits for its products. It serves original equipment manufacturers and end-users across sectors, such as material handling, logistics, intralogistics, food and beverage, packaging, textiles, metalworking, wastewater treatment, recycling, mining, biogas, construction equipment, agriculture and forestry machinery, ports and terminal equipment, road construction machinery, marine and offshore applications, and wind. Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Kanchipuram, India. Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bonfiglioli S.P.A.

Electro-mechanical engineering and HVAC services company that pairs project execution with recurring maintenance work. It serves industrial, offshore and data-centre infrastructure and reported FY26 revenue of about ₹278 crore.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (approx. ₹422 cr at ₹112)

ipos.brief: Fusion CX Limited provides integrated customer experience (CX) services in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Europe, and internationally. It offers its services across multiple channels, including voice, email, chat, social media, and message. Its services include customer acquisition, inbound and outbound sales, and cross-selling/upselling strategies; multichannel customer service across voice, chat, email, and social media and complaint handling; and efficient order fulfilment, covering order processing, returns, refunds, and billing support. It also assists with payment collections and debt resolution by managing early-stage collections and first-party omnichannel recovery efforts and support customer retention and loyalty through proactive outreach, feedback management, and loyalty programs; technical support, including L1/L2 troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and warranty services; and high-tech support, specializing in seller assistance, content moderation, and platform optimization for digital and technology-driven businesses. It provides Arya, an AI-powered platform that integrates conversational AI, real-time employee assist, AI-led quality monitoring, predictive analytics, and voice of customer into a unified ecosystem; MindVoice, a conversational AI platform that delivers AI-driven conversational voice bot and chatbot solutions; Mind Workplace that automates end-to-end HR processes from hire-to-retire, enhancing employee lifecycle management and MindSpeech, an AI-powered speech optimization tool that enhances voice communication by harmonizing accents, reducing noise, and improving clarity in real time. It serves telecom and utilities, healthcare and life sciences, high tech growth and travel, banking, financial services and insurance, and retail industries. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

RBI-registered NBFC (Vaibhav Vyapaar) that offers unsecured personal loans to salaried and self-employed borrowers through its LoanFront app, incorporated in 2009. It also provides technology and application support services to other NBFCs and moved to a co-lending model in FY26.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (₹152.19 cr at ₹54)

ipos.brief: HD Fire Protect Limited manufactures and supplies fire protection equipment and systems in India. The company offers sprinklers, flexible sprinkler drops, alarm valves, and accessories; deluge valves, deluge skids and pre-action systems; water spray nozzles; monitors and monitor nozzles; foam proportioning systems, foam equipment and devices, foam concentrates, and mobile equipment; systems valves and accessories, and handline nozzles; co2 fire suspension systems and inert gas fire suppression systems; and customized engineered systems, as well as spanning water suppression systems. Its products and solution are used in oil and gas, petrochemical and refining, power plants, commercial and residential buildings, hotels and airports, industrial and heavy engineering, data centres, ports and terminals, aviation, and other project industries. The company also exports. It operates in the Middle East, rest of Asia, South America, Europe, North America, Africa, and Oceania. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Thane, India.

Kolkata-based business founded in 2010 that grew from a fashion-accessories distributor into an integrated imitation-jewellery and cosmetics company. It combines contract manufacturing, wholesale distribution and retail.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at offer price (₹127.24 cr at ₹82)

ipos.brief: Vishal Nirmiti Limited, a civil engineering, manufacturing, and construction company, engages in the business of manufacturing and dealing in pre-stressed concrete sleepers for railways. The company operates in two segments, Manufacturing and Services. The company offers fabrication and erection of mild steel pipes (MS Pipes), MS liners, and penstock pipes for pumped storage project. It serves railways, renewable power, and industrial sectors. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Pune, India.

Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited engages in the design, manufacturing, and sale of lab-grown diamond studded gold jewellery in India. The company operates through an integrated business model comprising business-to-business (B2B) manufacturing and distribution to organized retailers, standalone retailers and wholesalers; and direct-to-consumer (D2C) omnichannel retail operations. It engages in procurement and management of raw materials, product design, manufacturing, quality control, distribution, branded retail and direct-to-consumer sales. The company offers a range of lab-grown diamond studded gold jewellery products across categories, such as rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, mangalsutras, nose pins, necklaces, cufflings and bangles, across daily wear, occasion-based. It also offers men's jewellery and customized segments. The company's B2B segment engages in the design, manufacture and supply of lab-grown diamond studded gold jewellery to a network of jewellery retailers across various states and union territories in India, as well as to overseas customers in United Arab Emirates, Australia, Canada, Taiwan and Kenya. Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Surat, India.

Gurugram-based MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions) and event management company incorporated in December 2020. It runs corporate events, conferences, incentive travel, virtual events and brand activations, with FY26 revenue of about ₹100 crore.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (₹143.77 cr at ₹118)

ipos.brief: Bikaner-rooted maker of papads, rice papads, vrat-special papads and moongodi under brands such as Zhakaas, Vishal, Rozana, Diamond and Papadmalji. Incorporated in 2017, it acquired the Vishal Namkeen Bhandar business and reported FY26 revenue of about ₹33.5 crore.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at offer price (₹67.63 cr at ₹72)

ipos.brief: Incorporated in 2014, Green Asia Impex sources, processes and exports frozen shrimp and dried chillies. It sells business-to-business to importers, distributors and food processors in India and abroad.

SRIT India Limited provides information technology and information technology enabled services in India and Internationally. It offers digital solutions and automations of systems through custom application development and integration services. The company through healthcare vertical, it provides integrated healthcare information technology solutions, such as information systems, revenue cycle management, digital health platforms and related system integration, implementation and maintenance services; through electronic governance vertical, it offers design, development, implementation and maintenance of e-governance platforms, cybersecurity solutions, enterprise software, and integrated digital service delivery systems for government and enterprise clients; and through telecommunications and broadband vertical, it provides networking, connectivity, system integration and managed services for telecommunications, broadband and digital infrastructure projects. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Shah Investor's Home Limited, a retail brokering company, provides equity and derivatives brokerage services in India. It facilitates the buying and selling of financial products, such as equities, initial public offering investing, mutual funds distribution, and other securities. The company also offers secondary market brokering services. Shah Investor's Home Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Runwal Enterprises Limited engages in residential and commercial real estate development in India. Its portfolio includes residential projects, apartments, retail spaces, offices, schools, hospitals, and town halls. The company also engages in the lease of commercial and shopping complexes. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Orient Cables (India) Limited engages in the manufacturing of networking cables and passive networking equipment in India and internationally. It manufactures networking cables, optical fiber cables, copper terminated assemblies, optical fiber terminated assemblies, coaxial cables, telecommunication cables, solar DC cables, power cables, and other products, including tethered drone system, EV charging cables and gun, power cord, power stripes/extension board, and keystone jack. Orient Cables (India) Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Solar company whose main line is solar water pumping systems, mostly for government projects, alongside solar PV module manufacturing and other solar products. It had implemented more than 85,000 HP of solar water pumping systems under government schemes as of March 2026.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (approx. ₹228 cr at ₹103)

ipos.company: German Green Steel and Power Limited
ipos.brief: German Green Steel and Power Limited manufactures and distributes iron and steel products. The company's products include TMT Bars, MS Billets, and Sponge Iron. German Green Steel And Power Limited was formerly known as Haq Steels and Metaliks Limited and changed its name to German Green Steel And Power Limited in May 2018. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Provides integrated IT and digital infrastructure solutions to government departments, public sector organisations, institutions and private-sector clients. Incorporated in 2007 and promoted by Vineet Kumar Gupta and Juli Gupta.
ipos.briefSource: Post-issue market cap at upper band (₹157 cr at ₹110); ~14.27M shares per Simply Wall St

ipos.brief: AceVector Limited establishes, develops, designs, and conceptualizes direct marketing and sales promotion solutions through web and non-web based platforms. It offers warehousing solutions, trading via e-commerce, and providing e-commerce platform for consumer goods. In addition, it is also involved in snapdeal, unicommerce, and stellaro brands businesses. AceVector Limited was formerly known as Snapdeal Limited and changed its name to AceVector Limited on January 06, 2023. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Moneyview Limited engages in the design, development, production, and distribution of various financial products in India. The company operates Moneyview, a financial service platform. Its platform offers personal, business, home, transfer home, and transfer property loans, as well as loans against property and credit cards; 24K gold and FD select; vehicle insurance; credit tracker; and UPI payment services. Moneyview Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
A-One Steels India Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of Iron and steel products in India. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Swastika Infra Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction services and engages in the execution of power T&D infrastructure projects in India. The company offers solutions on a turnkey basis, including the supply, erection, installation, testing, and commissioning of power infrastructure. It provides underground cabling work, including the laying, installation, and commissioning of high-voltage/low-voltage power cables; construction of substations, such as gas-insulated substations, air-insulated substations, and grid substations; rural and urban electrification projects; installation of street lighting systems; and renewable energy works. It also engages in the trading of electrical products, such as power cables and other electrical items. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Jaipur, India.

Pooja Logistics, incorporated in 2011, runs temperature-controlled trucking for perishable goods across India with a fleet of more than 424 GPS-enabled refrigerated vehicles. Its customers come from confectionery, dairy, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals and e-commerce.

Elevate Campuses Limited owns, operates, and manages on-campus student accommodations and K-12 schools in India. Its student accommodations include furnished rooms, dining services, on-site laundry, 24/7 security, recreation and activity zones, and collaborative study areas, as well as tech-enabled institutional platform for student communication. The company also leases school properties to school operators. It operates accommodations under the Good Host Spaces and ScholarZ names. The company was formerly known as Good Host Spaces Private Limited and changed its name to Elevate Campuses Limited in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India. Elevate Campuses Limited operates as a subsidiary of Genius Bidco Holdings Pte. Ltd.

Core Integra Consulting Services, incorporated in 2009, is an integrated human-resource solutions provider offering staffing, payroll outsourcing, labour-law compliance, HR advisory and vendor management. It also runs HR-tech and reg-tech platforms and serves over 600 customers across more than 30 industries.

ArMee Infotech Limited provides IT Infrastructure solutions and IT managed services for Government, PSUs, BFSI, education, and private sectors in India. It offers IT Infrastructure products, such as computers, servers, interactive panels and their peripherals; IT managed services, installation and integration of IT hardware and software products; Renewable Energy Space, such as renewable energy EPC services, renewable energy Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) services, renewable energy Battery Energy Storage System (BESS); and experience zones, engages in selling IT hardware and consumer goods, including computers and computer peripherals, consumer electricals, gaming products, and electronics. It also offers cyber-security solutions, including firewall, antivirus, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and encryption services; technical manpower; skill development training; annual maintenance services onsite and off-site operational support; and IT infrastructure maintenance services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Adroit Industries (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets auto parts and components in India. The company offers propeller shafts, driveshaft assemblies, and precision-machined torque-transmission components for automotive and non-automotive applications. It also provides cardan shafts, universal joints, sleeve and slip yokes, tube and weld yokes, flange and end yokes, companion flanges, yoke shafts, splined stub shafts, stub shafts, centre bearings, centre support bearings, short-coupled shafts, tubular shafts, mid-ship shafts, mechanics-style cardan parts and accessories, CV double cardan driveshaft assemblies, and forged products, as well as clutch plates, rubber parts, and spares. In addition, the company repairs a range of automotive components and parts. It sells its products through a network of distributors and Tier-1 driveline component suppliers, as well as through direct sales to original equipment manufacturers. The company exports its products to approximately 32 countries, including the United States, Colombia, Canada, Australia, Mexico, Turkey, the United Kingdom, Peru, and internationally. Adroit Industries (India) Limited was founded in 1966 and is based in Pithampur, India.

Varmora Granito Limited manufactures stones, tiles, bathware, sanitaryware, tile adhesives, and other application equipment accessories. Its product portfolio includes stock-keeping units for tiles, such as GVT and technical products, and PVT and ceramic tiles. The company offers its products for applications in residential and commercial spaces. It serves clients through a network of brand outlets, B2C retail channels, B2B channels, direct sales, and distributors in India and internationally. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Axiom Gas Engineering, incorporated in 2007, provides Auto LPG, CNG and LNG systems plus gas and pipe engineering, turnkey installations and statutory testing for retail and industrial customers. It also operates more than 20 Auto LPG dispensing stations under the PRIMEFUEL name across several Indian states.

SpectraA Technology Solutions, incorporated in 2009, is an engineering firm that designs, fabricates, installs and commissions industrial process plants, mainly for breweries, distilleries and food and beverage producers. It runs two manufacturing facilities in Bengaluru and Jaipur.

Sonaselection India Limited engages in the manufacturing and processing of textile fabrics in India. It offers cotton fabrics, cotton lycra fabrics, cotton blends, and polyester blends; and specialty finishes, including anti-microbial, Teflon, oil and water repellant, biomagical, enzyme, and bio-polishing. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Bhilwara, India.
Kheria Autocomp is an auto-ancillary company that manufactures plastic injection-moulded automotive components. It also performs sub-assembly operations for vehicle makers and tier-one suppliers.

SS Retail Limited sales consumer electronics products in India. It offers mobile phones, pre-owned mobile phones; bluetooth speakers, sound bars, and trolley/karaoke speakers; air buds/ear buds, neck bands, and headphones; smart watches; power banks and wireless power banks, power adaptors, chargers, type C cables, lightning cables, micro cables and multi-pin cables and memory cards, pen drives, and on the go pen drives; and televisions, laptops, and tablets, as well as wholesales mobile phones. The company also provides ancillary services, which includes mobile protection plans, anti-theft software, credit / EMI (equated monthly instalment) facilities, and recharge of mobile phones. It operates through stores. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Kolhapur, India.

Jindal Supreme (India) Limited engages in the manufacturing and supply of steel pipes and tubes for infrastructure and industrial applications in India. The company's products include mild steel (MS) black pipes and tubes, MS galvanized pipes and tubes, metal beam crash barriers, hollow sections, and galvanized iron tubular poles. The company serves various industries, such as water supply and plumbing, infrastructure and construction, road and highways, bridges, oil and gas, chemicals, agriculture, rural electrification, and others. Jindal Supreme (India) Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Hisar, India.

Hero Motors Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and supplies engineered powertrain solutions catering to automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in United States, Europe, India, and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations region. It operates through Powertrain Solutions and Alloys and Metallics segments. The company offers gears and transmission products comprising ice and EV gearboxes, e-axles, gearset assemblies, and gear and shaft components; bike powertrains products, such as continuous variable transmission products, electric motors, and electric drive units; and alloys and metallic products, including structural components, alloy frames, suspension forks, wheel rims, and BB catridges and seats, as well as design and validation services. The company's products have applications in two-wheelers, performance automotive, e-bikes, off-road vehicles, electric and hybrid cars, heavy duty vehicles, and electric vertical take-off and landing categories. Hero Motors Limited was formerly known as Hero Auto Limited and changed its name to Hero Motors Limited in September 2004. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Noida, India.

Manika Plastech Limited manufactures and sell polymer packaging products in India. The company offers precision battery casings, injection moulded plastic pail buckets, thinwall containers, water bottles, and detergent containers. It also provides painting services for plastic automotive components. The company's products are used in various industries applications, such as automotive, energy storage, railways, telecommunications, power back-up, paints, chemicals, coating, lubricants, agrochemicals, food, and dairy and edible food products. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Mumbai, India. Manika Plastech Limited is a subsidiary of VRIDAA Holding Trust.

Veegaland Developers Limited engages in the planning, development, and sale of multi storied residential apartment projects in India. It operates under the Veegaland Homes brand name. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Ernakulam, India.

Steamhouse India Limited develops, owns, operates, and maintains centralized steam generation plants and distributes industrial steam through pipeline networks to industrial customers. The company provides steam generation and distribution services, nitrogen compression and distribution, waste-to-steam solutions, utility plant operation and maintenance, and engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and utility management services. It also designs and operates boiler systems, pipelines, water treatment systems, pollution control equipment, and SCADA-based monitoring systems. It serves pharmaceuticals, chemicals, agrochemicals, textiles, tyres, dyes and pigments, polymers, paints, food processing, paper, and other manufacturing sectors. Steamhouse India Limited was formerly known as Ankleshwar Eco Energy Limited and changed its name to Steamhouse India Limited in September 2021. Steamhouse India Limited was founded in 2014 and is based in Surat, India with additional offices in Ankleshwar, Vapi, Sarigam, Nandesari, and Panoli, India.

Rentomojo Limited provides online rental service for furniture and appliances. The company provides rental services for various products, including delivery, installation, and pick-up. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

ipos.company: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited
ipos.brief: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited operates as a smart card manufacturer in India, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, Africa, North America, South America and internationally. The company offers solutions for cards, including banking, identity solutions, and loyalty cards; encompass card manufacturing, card personalization, cheque book printing, the supply of related collaterals, tax stamps, holograms, thermal paper rolls, and RFID products; and handles fulfilment activities, such as dispatch services. It also provides smart tagging and IOT solutions that include tax stamp solutions and IoT and traceability; secure logistics, insurance record management, and hologram and coated products; national ID cards, driving license and registration certificate, and intelligent transit management; and payment cards, smart wearables, cheque solutions, NFC/QR, and digital automation solutions. The company was formerly known as MCT Cards and Technology Private Limited and changed its name to Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Manipal, India. Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited operates as a subsidiary of Manipal Technologies Limited.

LCC Projects Limited operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction company in India. It engages in the construction of dams, barrages, weirs, hydraulic structures, canals, pipe distribution networks, lift irrigation works, water treatment and supply, metro rails, industrial buildings, road works, building works, mining, and other infrastructure development projects, as well as renewable energy and coal extraction projects. The company is also involved in project execution, such as excavation, backfilling, pipeline laying, pipeline welding and jointing, and the construction of structures, including intake well pump houses, elevated storage reservoirs, and sumps. In addition, it provides project consultancy services, scrap sale services, and tunnel construction services. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

Karamtara Engineering Limited manufactures and sells solar mounting structures and tracker components for the solar and transmission sectors in India, North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia. The company offers module mounting structures, tracker piles and piers, and torque tubes; lattice towers for transmission lines; wind towers and steel profiles; fasteners such as bolts, nuts, studs, and washers; and overhead transmission line hardware fittings and accessories, including insulator string fittings, jumper tubes, suspension clamps, vibration dampers, optical ground wire fittings, substation fittings and accessories, and fittings for power distribution lines. It serves independent power producers, original equipment manufacturers, and engineering, procurement, and construction companies. Karamtara Engineering Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Mumbai, India with additional offices in New York, New York; Solbiate Arno, Italy; Dammam, Saudi Arabia; and Palghar, Boisar, Butibori, and Kachchh, India.

Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited operates as an asset reconstruction company, acquiring and resolving distressed assets and non-performing loans. The company acquires, manages, and resolves stressed assets across corporate, SME, and retail segments, providing asset reconstruction services that include acquisition of non-performing assets, restructuring, settlement, and sale of assets. It conducts property auctions, manages settlement processes related to distressed assets, and engages in insolvency and bankruptcy resolution processes under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, in partnership with insolvency professionals and legal firms. The company also undertakes corporate social responsibility initiatives focused on education, vocational skills, livelihood enhancement, and environmental sustainability. The company serves corporate, SME, and retail clients with stressed assets, as well as banks, non-banking financial companies, legal professionals, advocates, and law firms involved in asset recovery and insolvency processes. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Mumbai, India. Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Avenue India Resurgence Pte Limited.

Prasol Chemicals Limited operates as an integrated manufacturer of acetone derivatives and phosphorous derivatives in India and internationally. Its products include acetone and phosphorous based specialty chemicals, and other specialty chemicals, as well as fertilizers and lubricants. The company's products are used in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, PICA viz., paints, inks construction, and adhesives, home and personal care, and performance chemicals. Prasol Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Thane, India.

Kanohar Electricals Limited engages in the transformer manufacturing business for industries including power transmission, railways, renewable energy, and power distribution in India. The company operates through two segments; transformer manufacturing business; and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Business. It manufactures transformers across various capacities ranging from 132 kV to 400 kV. The company's products include power transformers, traction transformers, Scott transformers, Shunt reactors, and distribution transformers. Its EPC Business services for substations include turnkey installation of air and gas insulated substations and bay augmentation in existing substations, and turnkey installation of transmission lines across 132 kV, 220 kV and 400 kV. Kanohar Electricals Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Meerut, India. Kanohar Electricals Limited operates as a subsidiary of K Sons Family Trust.

GLASS WALL SYSTEMS (INDIA) Limited engages in designing, manufacturing, and installation of building facades. The company offers glazing systems and architectural facade solutions designed for residential, commercial and industrial projects. It also utilizes advanced design and production software, dedicated production lines for unitized systems, doors, and windows, and operates manufacturing plants with in-house powder coating and sheet fabrication units. In addition, the company conducts skill training programs and workshops for designers and engineers. It operates in the United States, Australia, Qatar, Ireland, Sri Lanka, and Israel. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Pranav Constructions Limited engages in redevelopment of cooperative housing societies in India. It also involved in commerce, art, science, sports, education, research, social welfare activity, and other socio-economic development activities; and real estate development. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Deepa Jewellers Limited engages in designing, processing, and suppling of hallmarked gold and precious stone studded jewellery in India. The company offers vaddanam (waist belt), CNC machine cut bangles, gents kada, vanky(armlet), dandpatti (bajuband), gundlamala haaram (traditional neck piece), gundlamala necklace, kangan, earring, mangtika (forehead pendant), maatil (ear chain), champasaralu (ear to hair chain), jada (braid ornament), and rings. It also provides job work services by processing customer supplied materials into finished ornaments and trade in silver ornaments, 18 and 20 karat jewellry, and gold bullion. The company distributes its products to jewelry retail chains and standalone stores. Deepa Jewellers Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Purple Style Labs Limited operates as a fashion house, acquiring and managing designer brands and running an omni-channel platform for premium fashion retail. The company offers luxury fashion and lifestyle products, including premium designer wear, accessories, and jewellery through online and offline channels. It owns and manages multi-brand e-commerce websites such as Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, operates brick-and-mortar stores under the Pernia's Pop-Up Studio brand, and manages designer labels such as Wendell Rodricks and Hemant Trevedi. The company launches collaborations such as Six Yards by Madhuri Dixit, publishes a quarterly magazine focused on fashion and lifestyle, and has expanded into luxury home decor retail. Personal styling services are available both in-store and online. The company serves retail clients in the luxury fashion and home decor sectors, including consumers seeking designer wear, accessories, jewellery, and home products, as well as the global Indian diaspora, tourists, and local consumers interested in Indian design. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Priority Jewels Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, and sale of diamond-studded gold and platinum fine jewellery in India. Its portfolio includes daily wear jewellery, such as rings, earrings, pendants, mangalsutras, neckwear, bracelets, and occasion couture jewellery, as well as customized lab-grown diamond jewellery. The company sells its products to jewellery chains, including CaratLane Trading Private Limited, Kalyan Jewellers India Limited, Reliance Retail Limited, Malabar Gold & Diamonds FZCO, Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited, and Senco Gold Limited, as well as independent jewellers. It exports its products to Australia, Denmark, Hong Kong, Israel, Norway, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, Belgium, Japan, Fiji Island, Nepal, and Sweden. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is Mumbai, India.

ESDS Software Solution Limited operates as a provider of cloud and data center services, offering integrated solutions across cloud infrastructure, managed services, and software platforms. The company provides cloud infrastructure solutions, including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Software as a Service (SaaS), and managed services. It offers government community cloud (GCC) and enterprise community cloud (ECC) platforms, managed security services, advanced IT assistance, and pay-per-use models. Its digital IT solutions include ERP, CRM, mobile applications, digital twins, IoT integration, SAP HANA services, cloud customer portals, and near-line disaster recovery services. The company operates data centers and supports IT operations for clients. The company serves banking and financial services, government and public sector bodies, healthcare providers, commercial, residential, facility management, retail, and manufacturing enterprises, as well as small to mid-sized businesses. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Thane, India.

Lumino Industries Limited manufactures and sells conductors, power cables, electrical wires, and other products and components for power distribution and transmission industries in India and internationally. It offers aluminium conductors; LV XLPE/PVC insulated power, LV XLPE/PVC insulated control, LV aerial bunch, railway signalling, concentric, screened and instrumentation, solar, LV FR/FRLSH/FR-LSZH fire performance, underwriters laboratories, quad, medium voltage cross linked cables, as well as MV overhead covered conductors and electrical wires; and thermoset insulated, single-core service, and house wires. The company also develops power distribution and transmission infrastructure projects; constructs substations; and offers end-to-end solutions for transmission towers. In addition, it engages in the designing, engineering, procurement, testing, inspection, supply, installation, and commissioning of railway electrification projects and solar power plants. Further, the company offers water, sewage, and effluent treatment services; and raises and distributes water pipelines. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

Annu Projects Limited engages in the design, development, implementation, operations and maintenance of essential overhead and underground utilities infrastructure across telecom infrastructure, sewerage infrastructure vertical, gas pipeline vertical and railway signalling vertical in India. The company provides services, such as surveying, designing, and installing cabling and tower infrastructures for communication, automation, and electronic security systems, as well as undertakes the laying of overhead and underground optical fibre cable network for telecom operators. It also constructs manholes, sewerage treatment plants, pumping stations, structural facilities for sewerage, stormwater drainage systems, and screening chambers for combined or sanitary sewers, as well as pipe laying services. In addition, the company engages in the laying medium-density polyethylene for domestic and commercial gas supply. Annu Projects Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited develops, manufactures, and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India. The company provides cortico-steroid and hormone (Steroid) APIs; nutraceuticals; and other services. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Indore, India.

Skyways Air Services Limited operates as a logistics and freight forwarding service provider. The company offers freight forwarding, trucking, warehousing, customs brokerage, technology driven express cargo, and parcel delivery, as well as value-added services domestic and international markets. It also provides live animal transport and dangerous goods logistics services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Hy-Tech Engineers Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies hydraulic fittings to various industrial applications in India and internationally. The company provides DIN-metric, JIC flared and flareless, O-Ring Face Seal, and conversion fittings, as well as fittings customized to customer specifications. It serves various applications needs in construction machinery, automotive, agricultural machinery injection molding machines, and hydraulic systems, as well as railways and defense industries. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Thane, India.

Augmont Enterprises Limited operates as an integrated gold and silver platform in India. It engages in procurement and refining, bullion trading, digital gold offerings, jewellery manufacturing, international sales and facilitating gold-backed financial services. The company operates its enterprise sales vertical through its Augmont SPOT' platform, a fully electronic, over-the-counter delivery-based bullion platform that enables such as jewelers, bullion dealers, and manufacturers with valid GST registrations to purchase gold and silver bars online. It is also involved in the sale of gold bullion to asset management companies in exchange for units of gold exchange traded funds (ETF) and trade in gold and silver ETF units. In addition, the company manufactures and sells gold jewelry articles, which include chains to jewelry traders, as well as platinum. Further, it serves consumers through its Augmont Gold For All' platform by offering access to a range of gold and silver related services. The company's platform enables users to buy, sell, and store gold and silver digitally; purchase gold through systematic investment plans; liquidate and sell old gold; purchase coins starting from 1 gm; and avail technology support for gold loans. Augmont Enterprises Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Tempsens Instruments (India) Limited operates as a thermal engineering and specialised cable manufacturer in India and internationally. The company operates through verticals, such as Temperature sensing solutions, Electrical heating solutions, and Specialised cables. The Temperature sensing solutions vertical offers thermocouple, resistance temperature detector, infrared pyrometers, online thermal imagers, furnace monitoring camera, temperature gauges, pressure gauges and level gauges, diaphragm seals, thermowells and accessories, temperature transmitters, fiber optic temperature sensors, heat flux sensors, temperature calibrators, and diaphragm seal. The Electrical heating solutions vertical provides immersion, process, skid, cartridge, band, coil, air, printed, tubular, flexible, and furnace heaters; floor heating mats, comfort heating solutions, heating skid systems, and laboratory and process electrical furnaces. The Specialised cables vertical offers low voltage control and power wire/cable, instrumentation cable, thermocouple and RTD cable, nickel alloy conductors (thermocouple heating, pure nickel alloys), heat trace cable, and mineral insulated metal sheath cable. Additionally, it also offers fiber optic temperature sensors, aerospace-grade cables, catalyst bed heaters for space applications, slot resistance temperature detectors, mid-voltage heater, pressurizer heater for nuclear reactors, infrared pyrometers, and online thermal imagers. It serves the power generation, petro chemical, pharmaceutical, metal, defense and nuclear, steel, aluminium, railway, cement, glass, automotive, food processing, aerospace, and plastic industries. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Udaipur, India.

Gaja Alternative Asset Management Limited is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in turnaround, series C and investments in smaller end of middle market. The firm prefers to invest through growth capital and buyout. It also invests in acquisitions and shareholder settlement and considers buy-outs, turnarounds, and pre-IPO deals given an underlying growth thesis. It also invests in listed companies. The firm seeks to invest in technology and technology-enabled companies in software, consumer, services, SaaS, broad consumer services, manufacturing, infrastructure services, healthcare, human resource, financial services, education, and retail. It focuses on domestic sectors within India. It investments in mid-market companies and small and medium enterprises (SMEs). The firm invests between $5 million and $18.36 million in its portfolio companies and between $5 million and $30 million per company and enterprise value of maximum $150 million. It seeks minority investments and co-invests with global investor and India's successful entrepreneurs and leading business families. The firm exits its investments between three and seven years through initial public offerings, sale of the entire company, and sale of stake in the company. The firm seeks to take controlling stake. Gaja Alternative Asset Management Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Mumbai, India with an additional office in Mumbai, India and Delhi India.

Sunshine Pictures Limited engages in the business of film production, content development, media distribution, and allied entertainment services in India. The company offers production of feature films, web series, and television content. It is also involved in music production and distribution. It serves the entertainment industry by creating and distributing diverse media content across various platforms. Sunshine Pictures Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Shankesh Jewellers Limited provides handcrafted gold jewelry products and customization services in India. The company provides wholesale trade of 22-karat and 18-karat gold jewellery, including bangles, bridal jewellery, chokers, jhumkas, long and short necklace sets, mangal sutras, rings, and combined jewellery set in categories, such as antique, semi-antique, Calcutta, temple, gheru polish, and yellow/rhodium/rose gold jewellery. The company serves corporate jewellery brands and independent retailers, catering to their needs for weddings, festivals, and daily wear. The company was formerly known as Shankesh Jewellers Private Limited and changed its name to Shankesh Jewellers Limited in April 2025. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited designs, manufactures, and sells gold, silver, diamond, and other jewellery products in India and internationally. The company offers a range of jewellery options, including chains, rings, bangles, necklaces, haarams, earrings/drops, pendants, bridal jewellery, gemstone jewellery, coins, silverware, divine idols, and customized jewellery products. It also provides products for women, men, kids, and teenagers under the Lalithaa brand name. It serves customers through a network of large format stores and medium format stores in South India. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

Horizon Industrial Parks Limited engaged in the business of developing, operating, and maintaining industrial and warehousing parks in India. It offers industrial and logistic parks, fulfillment centers and industrial facilities, and in-city centers. The company also offers turnkey solutions, energy solutions, on-site staff accommodation and skill development centers, cold storage, and hospitality. It caters to the auto, engineering and aerospace, logistics and supply chain, FMCG and retail, packaging, e-commerce, energy, and chemicals industries. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Shiprocket Limited provides e-commerce enablement platform solutions in India. It offers Shiprocket Shipping, an e-commerce shipping platform that automates workflows across sales channels; ShiprocketX, an end-to-end cross border solution; fastrr, AI native growth suite for commerce brands; Shiprocket Fulfillment, a warehousing, and packaging and shipping solution; Shiprocket Trends; and Shiprocket Capital, a revenue-based financing platform. The company also provides Shiprocket Packaging for packaging solutions; Shiprocket Cargo, a platform that offers end-to-end logistics partner for domestic freight movement; Shiprocket Omuni, an unified commerce platform; Shiprocket Promise for shopping; Shiprocket Amplify, an influencer marketing solution; Shiprocket Quick, a delivery solution; Delivery Boost, a delivery solutions; and Shiprocket Sense for address and risk intelligence to minimise address inaccuracies and delivery failuresa. It serves small businesses, retail brands, direct-to-consumer merchants, and social commerce retailers. Shiprocket Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Behari Lal Engineering Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of iron and steel products in India. The company manufactures metal rolls for rolling mills across various grades including alloy cast steel rolls, alloy steel base adamite rolls, graphitic steel rolls, S. G. Iron Pearlitic Rolls, S. G. Iron Bainitic/Accicular Rolls, alloyed indefinite chill rolls, and forged rolls used in rolling processes to produce finished steel products such as TMT rebar and structural steel. It also offers engineering castings in various grades for industries including steel, iron, mining and aggregate crushers, power, and sugar; carbon, alloy steel, tool steel, valve steel, and stainless steel bars in various sections such as rounds, round corner square, flats and hex, with different sizes; forging ingots and forged shafts/ blocks for application in industries, such as automotive, aerospace, oil & gas, energy, and heavy engineering. The company caters to industries such as automobile, steel, mining, infrastructure and construction, power, aerospace and defence, and cement. It sells its products in India, Afghanistan, Brazil, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, South Africa, Tanzania, Togo, Uganda, UAE, and the USA. Behari Lal Engineering Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Delhi, India.

Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited produces and supplies dairy products. It engages in food processing, and manufacturing and trading of food products. The company provides dairy products including cheese, paneer, butter, curd, ghee, yogurt, ice cream, milk cream, and UHT milk products. It also offers ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook products, such as frozen pizza, paneer crunchies, paneer tikka, paneer finger, dahi tikki, cheese balls, wheat chapati, malabar parota, coin parota, ragi, idly and dosa batter, and various payasam mix; chocolates and sweetened condensed milk; and traditional Indian sweets such as shrikhand, kalakhand, payasam, mishti doi, and rasgulla. In addition, the company provides beverages, includes lassi, milkshakes, buttermilk, and flavored yogurts; cream, milk powder, flavoured milk, lassi, etc.; and khova. It sells its products under the Milky Mist, Smartchef, Capella, Briyas, and Asal brand names. The company also exports its products to Australia, Bahrain, Brunei, Congo, Ghana, Hong Kong, Kuwait, Maldives, Mauritius, New Zealand, Nigeria, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Seychelles, Singapore, Sri Lanka, the United Arab Emirates, and the United States. Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Perundurai, India.

Molbio Diagnostics Limited, a point-of-care diagnostics company, provides healthcare technologies to diagnose infectious and non-communicable diseases. It manufactures and sells chip based diagnostic devices, chips and reagents, X-ray equipment's, and single/dual detectors. It also offers disposable POCT devices, which includes dengue, malaria, and COVID-19 tests; Tabletop analysers, a portable machine that are used to perform molecular or immunodiagnostic tests to detect infectious diseases, such as tuberculosis, human papillomavrus, STIs, and GI disorders. In addition, the company offers Truenat, a multi-disease real-time polymerase chain reaction platform that enables treatment decisions for various infectious and non-communicable diseases, such as tuberculosis, human immunodeficiency virus, malaria, viral hepatitis, COVID-19, dengue, chikungunya, influenza, H1N1, HPV/cervical cancer, cholera, leprosy, etc.; and Truenat assays. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Verna, India.

Dhoot Transmission Limited operates as a manufacturer of wiring harnesses, automotive switches, electronic sensors and controllers, connectors, terminals, automotive cables, power cords, and related components. The company provides wiring harnesses for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, commercial vehicles, off-road vehicles, farm equipment, earth movers, medical equipment, and domestic appliances. It manufactures electronic sensors and controllers, automotive switches, connection systems, connectors and terminals, automotive cables, and power cords. The company offers electric vehicle products, including charging guns, inlets, off-board chargers, residual current devices, high voltage and low voltage wiring harnesses, and lithium-ion battery assembly, serving both internal combustion engine and electric vehicle segments. The company supplies its products to original equipment manufacturers in the automotive, medical equipment, and domestic appliances sectors. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Aurangabad, India.

Technocraft Ventures Limited engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) turnkey projects. It develops EPC of water supply scheme projects (WSSPs), sewerage networks, sewerage treatment plants (STPs), wastewater treatment plants, transmission mains, and reservoirs water and wastewater infrastructures; EPC of road and highway projects; residential buildings; power transmission and distribution networks, electrical substations, and electrification schemes; trenchless, pipeline installation, and micro tunnelling works; and operation and maintenance of micro-tunneling and trenchless methods, STPs, water supply scheme projects, and sewer networks. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Noida, India. Technocraft Ventures Limited operates as a subsidiary of Kartikey Constructions.

Ardee Industries Limited engages in the recovery and recycling of end-of-life energy storage products and non-ferrous scrap while claiming resources from waste streams. The company's products include pure lead and lead alloys comprising lead calcium, lead antimony, lead tin, lead silver, and lead cadmium alloys that applies in energy storage, e-mobility, automotive, chemical, and other industries. It operates in India, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, Japan, Saudi Arabia, and United States of America. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
